sd_core_errors.select: sdSelectCard(): Select Failed after 500 ms ready wait

interpretation: Live USB remains at 4 Hz while SD is unavailable. New captures are counted as missed, not retained in a retry backlog or uploaded. Repeated FR_NOT_READY plus select timeouts localize this occurrence to card initialization/response, not post-mount journal write/readback. Cached journal bytes of zero are not evidence that the physical journal is empty.
privacy: Aggregates only; no VIN, coordinates, credentials, or sensor values.
